log.marshal_delivery_log: webhook: marshal payload for delivery log (endpoint={endpoint})

delivery.blocked: Could not connect: the egress policy blocks {host} (a private or loopback address)
delivery.no_such_host: Could not connect: {host} did not resolve
delivery.dns_failed: Could not connect: could not resolve {host} (the daemon's DNS failed)
delivery.refused: Could not connect: {host} refused the connection
delivery.unreachable: Could not connect: there is no network route to {host}
delivery.tls: Could not connect: the TLS certificate of {host} is not valid
delivery.timeout: Could not connect: {host} did not answer in time
